title: Inbox
one_line: Messages and gifts from the team, with a CLAIM on attachments.

anatomy.spec: Message rows (bible 5.7): sender/system icon, subject, date, and if there is a gift attachment a CLAIM button on the row.
Bible 5.22 empty state when there is nothing.

data: Server-driven messages, likely tied to Firebase Cloud Messaging / Firestore once the backend exists (T-A1 onward).
do_not: Do not let a message with an attachment be dismissible without claiming or clearly stating the gift expired.
acceptance: Claiming a gift updates the wallet and removes the CLAIM button.
steps: 1. Preflight - this depends on backend messages existing (Phase A/B); build the UI now against mock data.
2. Build the standard-card chassis with message rows and CLAIM.
4. Wire to real messages once the backend exists.
5. Capture populated, empty and loading. Postflight.
